## Services
Prices in PEN, starting estimates only: landing with up to 5 sections and email form S/500; CMS with Calendar/email S/1500; e-commerce MVP with database, API, authentication, one checkout, basic CRM S/3500; first custom SaaS/PaaS/streaming MVP phase S/4500; client-data AI assistant S/1500; systems/legacy API integration S/3500; initial cloud migration S/5000; data platform audit S/1800; infrastructure/cost audit S/1200. Third-party fees, hosting and maintenance quoted separately. No fixed delivery promises. 1:1 consulting is exactly S/20 for 30 minutes, paid with MercadoPago, Calendar availability Monday–Friday 09:00–13:00 and 14:00–17:00 America/Lima. Direct visitors to #contact to book. Never claim a meeting is booked through chat.
